title: #398: does the Java/Spring adapter ship in this PR?
context: Verified: FRAMEWORK_PACKAGE_MAP (src/core/stack-profile.ts:18) has NO jvm entry (and no django/fastapi/rails), so the framework-API builder would select zero packages for a Spring project even with a perfect adapter. Java jars also live outside the project (~/.m2, ~/.gradle caches with a hash dir), and reading pom.properties + @Deprecated bytecode needs a hand-rolled ZIP + class-file parser in Node (no zip dep; typescript is our only optional peer). PHP/Laravel and Python both have in-project install trees and are pure-JS parseable.

options.label: Ship PHP/Laravel + Python now, JVM as a follow-up issue
Ship PHP + Python + Java/Spring in this PR

rationale: Haider wants #398 delivered whole: PHP/Laravel + Python + Java/Spring in one PR. Accepts the JVM cost — jar resolution from ~/.m2 and ~/.gradle, a hand-rolled ZIP + class-file reader, and new jvm/django/fastapi entries in FRAMEWORK_PACKAGE_MAP.
